source_provenance.catalog: Already supplied as exact authored metadata in the Android source tree.
source_provenance.ca: Mozilla/curl CA bundle, MPL-2.0. DriftDroid runtime/assets/certs/cacert.pem pinned Git blob; exact APK bytes are that blob with CRLF line endings.
source_provenance.dsp: Dolphin-authored free DSP coefficient table (GPL-2.0-or-later), Data/Sys/GC/dsp_coef.bin. DriftDroid pinned runtime/assets/dsp/dsp_coef.bin exact. Free DSP source: https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/tree/master/docs/DSP/free_dsp_rom.
source_provenance.wc24: Dolphin-authored default WiiConnect24 bootstrap data, GPL-2.0-or-later, Data/Sys/Wii/shared2/wc24. DriftDroid pinned runtime/assets/wii tree matches binary payloads; mailbox Readme differs only by CRLF. No owner NAND/account data.
source_provenance.bootstrap_docs: WiiDS first-run bootstrap README and Dolphin mailbox README; exact retained text. Mailbox README matches upstream with CRLF.
source_provenance.pipeline: Aurora portable pipeline recipe DB, generated render metadata, not a GPU driver cache or game assets. Main copy from pinned DriftDroid; other 3 copies from pinned NSMB Wii runtime/assets/pipeline/initial_pipeline_cache.db.
source_provenance.shader: Galaxy upstream generated material ShaderUid/PipelineKey manifest. Exact tracked Galaxy pin assets/galaxy_shader_manifest.bin. tools/cook/generate_shader_manifest.py deterministically regenerates it from privately cooked owner-disc assets.
source_provenance.cooker: Galaxy actual shipped Python/JSON sources. Source inputs preserved as individual text members; Build-Importer.py retains the PC-to-embedded adaptations. Recreate ZIP from recorded metadata with CPython 3.12/zlib 1.3.1 level 6.
source_provenance.pythonhome: Pinned Galaxy base Pythonhome ZIP and 7 hashed Chaquopy wheels. Rebuild appended members with recorded metadata using CPython 3.12/zlib 1.3.1 level 6. Exact recipe; no wheel binaries in source archive.
source_provenance.mod: Unchanged official MSMBWii creator archive, http://riivolution.nanolx.org/MSMBWii.zip. Exact 3,007,052-byte release. Existing owner-reported author permission recorded in docs/release/PERMISSIONS.md; written replies not retained there.
